content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to. Research shows you can build similar muscle across a wide range, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets finish close to failure (about 0-3 reps left). Lighter loads need more reps and more fatigue per set to get there. 💪

Your goal is a 100 kg bench, so you do need heavy work for that. Strength is specific, and you get better at heavy singles by practicing heavy sets. Use heavier sets of 3-6 reps on the bench, and use moderate reps (8-15) on accessories for size. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
